ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites strictly enforced. Priority registration given to Juniors and Seniors majoring in Dietetics. Juniors and Seniors majoring in Hospitality Management can register at the start of Sophomore registration. HM students have priority registration for spring, and dietetics students have priority registration for fall.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Restricted to BS:F Sci&Hm Nutr-Diettcs -UIUC or BS:FSci&Hm Nutr-Hosp Mgt -UIUC.
